concepts.name: model
concepts.definition: A hosted model: one exact public model identifier in the global catalog, such as google/gemma-4-31b-it, that a request names and the gateway serves with no alias or fallback.

concepts.name: gateway
concepts.definition: The Rust service on the inference hot path that authenticates Gradiated API keys, selects the exact hosted model, admits, streams and cancels each generation, and finalizes its charge.

concepts.name: provider
concepts.definition: An upstream inference company, such as Anthropic or OpenAI, whose API the proxy relays to with the customer's own provider key; a machine supplier is a GPU provider.

concepts.name: deployment
concepts.definition: A model deployment: one concrete runtime that serves one model release at a private service URL, derived from Kubernetes pods, among which the gateway places requests.

concepts.name: generation
concepts.definition: One inference request as served: one generation identifier names its charge, its captured contents and the reference the client receives.

concepts.name: credential
concepts.definition: A secret a caller presents for authentication: a Gradiated API key, stored only as its SHA-256 digest, or a customer provider key the proxy passes through without storing.

concepts.name: release
concepts.definition: A model release: the pinned runtime image, model weights and tokenizer that a deployment serves, identified by its served release digest.

concepts.name: proxy
concepts.definition: The thin customer-key proxy in front of the gateway: it relays a request that carries a customer provider key to that provider and forwards a hosted-model request to the gateway.

concepts.name: workspace
concepts.definition: A policy and cost-attribution boundary inside an organization that groups API keys, usage and captured generation contents; it is not an authorization boundary.

concepts.name: organization
concepts.definition: The tenant and human authorization boundary: its active members reach every workspace in it, and it owns one billing account; its kind is customer or distribution channel.

concepts.name: settlement
concepts.definition: The worker path that posts finalized generation charges to PostgreSQL as one idempotent balance transaction per organization and global slot.

concepts.name: relay
concepts.definition: A request the proxy sends to an upstream provider with the customer's own provider key; a relay has no balance check, price lookup or charge.

concepts.name: capture
concepts.definition: Copying of a generation's prompt and response into regional storage as trace contents, enabled by default per workspace with 180-day retention.

concepts.name: trace
concepts.definition: The captured contents of one generation, kept for the retention period its workspace recorded when it was captured.

concepts.name: balance
concepts.definition: An organization's monetary position in integer nano-USD: durable in PostgreSQL balance transactions and operational in the Valkey gateway account.

concepts.name: desmond
concepts.definition: The per-host agent beside each model runtime that decides whether its replica is routable and reports that readiness to the deployment status ingest route.

concepts.name: kev
concepts.definition: The pinned jaredpalmer/kev-9b model and its native runtime, served only through the gateway's POST /v1/systemone dispatch and never through Chat Completions.

concepts.name: GPU reservation
concepts.definition: Allocated provider GPU capacity held by a running provider pod; stopping, resetting, re-imaging or changing provider settings can release it.
